base.name: offset-heavy-tee-color-lineup
base.prompt: Use case: product-mockup. Images 1, 2 and 3 are the exact SIDEFORM Offset Heavy Tee product references in Black, White and Grey. Create ONE photorealistic studio product photograph showing EXACTLY THREE matching oversized T-shirts, one Black, one true White, one Grey, hanging side by side from slim clean hangers on a simple black horizontal clothing rail. All THREE garment fronts must be visible, preserve each reference's oversized short-sleeve cut, dropped shoulders, ribbed crew neckline, fabric, and small two-offset-horizontal-rectangle chest mark (off-white on Black, black on White/Grey). Left to right Black, White, Grey. No other colors, no jackets, no models, no text, no unrelated logos, no interface elements. Pale neutral grey/off-white studio background and floor, soft light/shadows matching a minimal fashion product gallery. Portrait 4:5 framing with full garments visible and tidy spacing, rail near upper third, garments filling the center without excessive empty space. Garments should look like the same product in three colorways, not three different designs.

The OTHER TWO COLORS must be turned away at approximately 65–90 degrees, showing SIDE/BACK and sitting slightly BEHIND the selected tee; do NOT show their fronts facing camera. Preserve the exact same garment cut, fabric, pale neutral studio background, slim black rail and hangers, soft shadows, and portrait 4:5 composition. Selected tee is fully visible including both sleeves and hem with clear margins, no garment cut off at image edges. No text, labels, watermarks, models, interface, jackets or unrelated graphics. Other shirts' plain backs have no printed logos. This is one realistic photograph, not a collage.
